text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E after substantial gains felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on valuation, risk, and portfolio goals—not the satisfaction of locking in gains alone.","My loss aversion can make losses feel especially painful; I should avoid holding a position just to avoid realizing a loss and instead reassess its outlook objectively.","Recent trades added to several stocks, so I should monitor concentration and keep enough cash while making sure each purchase fits my risk and diversification plan."]}
